content:
Developers can now submit apps built for iOS 27 and other brand new operating systems, getting ready before the official launch next Monday. Here are the details.

Developers can now submit apps for iOS 27

At the "Surprise and Shine" event held yesterday, Apple confirmed that iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27 will officially debut next Monday (September 14).

Apple announced today that developers can now download the Xcode 27 Release Candidate and submit apps and games built with the latest SDK for review.

Apple also took this opportunity to remind developers that macOS 27 will only support software built for Apple silicon:

In addition, Apple reminded developers to answer the newly added age rating questions for features such as "Time Allowances," and encouraged them to prepare their App Store listings, including adopting new product page titles and search result assets. Updated design guidelines and templates have been provided for product pages, screenshots, app previews, and In-App Events.

Apple reiterated at the end: "Starting April 2027, apps and games uploaded to App Store Connect must meet the following minimum requirements":

  • iOS and iPadOS apps must be built with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 SDK or later
  • tvOS apps must be built with tvOS 27 SDK or later
  • visionOS apps must be built with visionOS 27 SDK or later
  • watchOS apps must be built with watchOS 27 SDK or later

To read Apple's full blog post on the Developer website, please click this link.
